description: This file defines a migration class for version 5.0.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to modify the database schema, update configuration, manage permissions, localization strings, and menu configuration related to HRM modules such as attendance, leave, time, and admin. The class extends an abstract migration class and utilizes Doctrine DBAL for database operations.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Installer\Migration\V5_0_0\Migration
classes.description: Migration class implementing database schema changes and configuration updates for OrangeHRM version 5.0.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema modifications, permission updates, localization changes, and menu configuration adjustments necessary for this migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string for this migration, '5.0'.

methods.name: configureTimeMenuItemsIfTimesheetStartDateDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items under 'Time' based on the timesheet start date configuration.

methods.name: configureLeaveMenuItemsIfLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items under 'Leave' based on whether the leave period is defined.

methods.name: configureMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to set the status of menu items under a parent menu based on configuration.

methods.name: addTimezoneColumnsToAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Adds timezone-related columns to the attendance record table and updates timezone offsets.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configurator class associated with specific screens and modules.

methods.name: updateModuleDisplayNames
methods.description: Updates display names for system modules.

methods.name: insertI18nGroups
methods.description: Inserts localization groups for attendance, help, and auth.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TranslationHelper.

methods.name: cleanUniqueIdTable
methods.description: Deletes entries from the hs_hr_unique_id table excluding 'hs_hr_employee'.

methods.name: hideAddonMenuItems
methods.description: Hides specific menu items related to Claim and LDAP Configuration by setting their status to false.
